name: Fork
primary:
Lightning from your hand that forks through a crowd.
Lightning shoots from your hand into the creature you aim at (or the first one in your line of sight). Effects:
• Damage 2.75 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 105: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 6 targets in a row, jumps up to 5 blocks, 1.25 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
